title: Investigating the adsorption performance of calcium-rich biochar on CDOM from actual rifapentine pharmaceutical wastewater using spectroscopic techniques
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,914-924
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW01002G, Paper
Jiali Liu, Qian Wen, Maoyun Xu, Yuhuan Wu, Xujing Guo
Chromophoric dissolved organic matter can be effectively adsorbed and removed by calcium-rich biochar. The study provides valuable insights for the development of efficient technologies for the treatment of actual pharmaceutical wastewater.
